name: SweynTooth
summary: Family of BLE link-layer/L2CAP flaws across multiple MCU vendor SDKs enabling DoS, deadlocks, and in some cases MitM/key issues.
related_papers: SweynTooth: Unleashing Mayhem over Bluetooth Low Energy

name: BrakTooth
summary: Directed fuzzing of Bluetooth Classic LMP found widespread issues affecting 1400+ products; ESP32 used as attack radio.
related_papers: BrakTooth: Causing Havoc on Bluetooth Link Manager via Directed Fuzzing

name: ESP32 / ESP-IDF Bluetooth stack advisories
summary: Espressif BT stack issues surfaced around BrakTooth-era research; track Espressif security advisories for current CVE IDs.

name: STM32/NXP SDK bugs found by uAFL
summary: uAFL paper reports multiple CVEs in STM32/NXP SDK samples via ETM-guided fuzzing; exact IDs depend on vendor disclosures.
related_papers: uAFL: Non-intrusive Feedback-driven Fuzzing for Microcontroller Firmware

name: Fuzzware-found MCU firmware crashes
summary: Fuzzware evaluation discovered numerous crashes/bugs in open and commercial Cortex-M firmware via automated MMIO modeling.

name: P2IM-found MCU firmware bugs
summary: P2IM demonstrated scalable bug finding in MCU firmware without vendor HAL source via peripheral modeling.

name: MCUboot image validation advisories (class)
summary: Track MCUboot security advisories for image parse/validation issues affecting MCU secure boot chains.

name: MCU secure boot fault-injection class
summary: Voltage/EM glitching against MCU secure boot is a practical attack class; wolfBoot documents redundant-check countermeasures.

name: Cortex-M TrustZone-M / TF-M misconfiguration class
summary: Misconfigured SAU/MPC/PPC or NSCallable veneers undermine TrustZone-M isolation on Cortex-M33/M55 class MCUs.

name: RP2040/Pico bootrom and USB-boot research class
summary: Research around RP2040 bootrom/USB boot paths and faulting; track Raspberry Pi security bulletins for concrete CVEs.

name: Nordic SoftDevice / nRF BLE stack advisories
summary: Nordic SoftDevice BLE controller issues overlap SweynTooth-era findings; monitor Nordic Security Advisories.

name: STM32 Cube HAL USB/peripheral CVE class
summary: Periodic ST security notices for Cube USB/device stacks used by bare-metal apps; track via ST PSIRT.
